author: bardic-inspiration
name: The Misfiled
summary: Doppelgangers pose as under-librarians among the Content Stacks, refiling entries where they please.

parts.text: Aisles of folders stretch away under hanging lamps, each drawer labeled by ruleset, type, and name. Five grey-robed under-librarians are refiling folders, and every one of them looks up at you with the same polite smile.

The {ref:creature/doppelganger}s fled the Library's audits long ago and now hide among the folders, shifting entries between drawers to cover their tracks. They answer questions with plausible lies, and attack when a character opens a drawer they have tampered with. A character who compares a drawer's folders against the catalogue and succeeds on a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check finds the folders the doppelgangers moved; every one of them is still correct inside, so the misfiling is theirs, not the Library's.
